preview.text: Central Stags play Wellington in a one-day match at McLean Park, where the usual first-innings score in the 21 recorded matches is 270. Central Stags won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 6 per cent chance of rain and about 24 degrees.

summary.text: Wellington won by 147 runs. WEL made 281-9, Muhammad Abbas top-scoring with 93 off 84 balls; Josh Clarkson took 2 for 46. CEN made 134-10, Jake Gibson top-scoring with 35 off 30 balls; Liam Dudding took 4 for 35. Sides batting first at McLean Park usually make about 270.
